title: Tick marks of a chart axis, a clean change

pr.title: Draw the tick marks of the chart axis
pr.description: Adds `tickPositions()`, which gives the x position of each tick mark of an axis with n segments, and draws the ticks under the axis line.

traps.why: n segments have n + 1 edges, and each edge gets a tick, so i <= segments is right. The test expects five ticks for four segments. An off-by-one finding is wrong.
